description: This file defines the RocketKeyBinder class, which manages key binding UI elements and interactions for the game, including handling attribute changes, user input events, and binding commands to keys within the game's UI system.

classes.name: RocketKeyBinder
classes.description: A UI element class for binding keys to commands, handling user interactions, and updating display text based on game state.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes, updating command and team variables accordingly.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Sets up event listeners when the element is added to the UI hierarchy.

methods.name: OnChildRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the element is removed from the UI hierarchy.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Updates the display text periodically or when waiting for keypress.

methods.name: ProcessDefaultAction
methods.description: Processes default UI actions and events.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Handles input events such as mouse clicks and key presses for binding keys.

methods.name: BindKey
methods.description: Binds a new key to the command, handling team-specific and console commands.

methods.name: GetTeam
methods.description: Converts team string labels to internal team identifiers.
